title: Casa Mesa • Private Paradise w Pool, Putt, & Games
description:
Plan your next escape to this amenity-packed 6-bedroom retreat in Mesa, designed for relaxing, gathering, and making unforgettable Arizona memories.

• Private Pool & Hot Tub
• BBQ Grill & Outdoor Patio/Dining
• Fire Pit & Seating Area
• Game Room: Ping Pong/Air Hockey Table, Arcade & Board Games
• Giant Connect 4, Jenga, Mini Golf, & Corn Hole
• Fully Stocked Kitchen
• Family/Kid Friendly
• Washer & Dryer
• High Speed Wifi
• Ample Parking

 The space 
Welcome to Casa Mesa! This spacious 6-bedroom, 3-bathroom home comfortably sleeps up to 20 guests, making it perfect for big families, friend getaways, or group adventures.

Inside, you’ll find bright, open living spaces designed for gathering, relaxing, and making memories together. Whip up delicious meals in the fully stocked kitchen, then gather around the dining table or settle into the cozy living areas to share stories, play games, and unwind after a day of fun in the backyard or exploring the area.

The backyard is the ultimate spot to relax and have fun, with plenty of space to lounge, play, and soak up the Arizona sun. Plus, a separate backyard addition offers a game room and the 6th bedroom, giving even more space to enjoy. With two bunk beds and games right next door, it’s the perfect hangout and sleep space for kids, teens, or anyone seeking their own private retreat.

Located just minutes from downtown Mesa’s top attractions, parks, and restaurants, you can spend your days exploring the best of the area and your evenings relaxing in comfort. Whether you're planning a lively family vacation, a reunion with friends, or a laid-back desert escape, Casa Mesa offers plenty of room, fun amenities, and the perfect home base for an unforgettable Arizona getaway.

GUEST VERIFICATION:
To help ensure a smooth and secure stay for all guests, the primary guest listed on the reservation may be asked to complete a quick verification process within 48 hours of booking, depending on the platform used to book the reservation.

Prior to check-in, guests may also be asked to sign a Rental Agreement that includes agreeing to our rental terms and conditions and, on certain booking platforms, providing a valid government-issued ID and matching credit card before arrival.

Included with your booking is our damage waiver coverage, which helps protect against accidental, self-reported damage during your stay when reported prior to check-out.
